notes: *to day* is the ASV's hyphenated adverb for הַיּוֹם, tokenized in two: one rendering of which no morpheme owns a part, so the article and noun share a unit under rule 30's one-rendering reading, headed on the noun carrying the lexeme. Giving *to* to the article alone was the competing reading and has no lexical support.
The assimilated article of בַשָּׁמֶן is unrepresented under rules 12 and 29, the ASV writing *with oil* anarthrously; the assimilated token is nonetheless a real token and is aligned as its own unit.
לִזְבֹּחַ is rule 52's written-preposition case: the לְ takes *to* and the infinitive keeps *sacrifice*.
